day: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide 2:1 website Hero landscape of Mount Fuji viewed across a tranquil Japanese lake. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its detailed painterly digital illustration, warm atmospheric depth and fine brushwork, not its composition. New fixed composition for a seven-weather/time set: Mount Fuji snowcap centered at x=58%, summit at y=38%, lake shore at y=65%, blue lake bottom third, small dark pine silhouettes at far edges only, open sky top third. Bright clear midday, beautiful natural blue and emerald colors, detailed but calm. No people, buildings, writing, logos, visible sun disk, moon, stars or foreground objects. Sun and moon will be added programmatically, do not paint them. Whole image full bleed, no fade or UI overlays. Generate high quality 2000x1000 or similar exact 2:1.

warm late sunset, amber and peach sky, soft violet distant mountains, golden reflections on lake, warm light from the right
deep midnight, indigo navy sky, subtle small stars, blue silver snowy summit and dark pine silhouettes, low light silver reflections on the lake
